verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim works as a simulation sandbox for robot stacks. The docs describe evaluating end-to-end systems with software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop testing, validating robot stacks with ROS 2, and plugging into existing testing and validation pipelines. ROS 2 services can load worlds, spawn entities and step simulations, and Isaac Lab runs headless, so testing happens in simulation rather than on real robots or real-world data. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of isolating sandbox from production data or of any environment-promotion workflow, no hands-on or community corroboration of agent-driven sandbox testing.
